phase2.text:
University of Connecticut Travel and Entertainment Procedures, version effective 2026-02-01: The University Travel Card charges must be submitted within 60 days of the trip end date or transaction date. If they are not submitted within that period, the card will be suspended. If the charges remain unresolved after 90 days, the traveler may be referred to Human Resources for possible disciplinary action and/or payroll deductions may be initiated in accordance with the Travel Card Agreement.[1]
University of Connecticut Travel and Entertainment Procedures, version effective 2026-07-01: The submission deadline for University Issued Travel Card charges is within 30 days of the transaction date or the trip end date, whichever is later.[2] If charges are not submitted and fully approved within 60 days of the transaction date or the trip end date, the card will be suspended.[2] If charges remain unresolved after 90 days, the traveler may be referred to Human Resources for possible disciplinary action, and/or payroll deductions may be initiated in accordance with the Travel Card Agreement.[2]
